summary: Held the entire episode. This LONG oscillated in a wide but ultimately favorable band, printing repeated dips (-9 to -19pts) that each recovered within 1-2 frames back to +10 to +22pts, with lambda_hat_21/30 staying positive and statistically significant (t=3-4) through every dip, signaling persistent mean-reversion pull back in the trade's favor. The deepest dip (-19pts at t=22m, the last frame) never got confirmation of a structural breakdown before the window closed, and the thesis-intact pattern (fast recovery, positive lambda) held throughout, so no EXIT was warranted. Next time I'd watch for lambda_hat flipping negative and staying there across multiple TFs simultaneously, plus a lower-low structure on the 1m/5m that fails to reclaim prior support, as the real wrong-direction confirmation rather than single-frame price dips alone.
